sample_unit: ED triage cases with paired proxy-variable qualifiers

links.outcome: LLM triage severity changes when patient proxy variable qualifiers (32 paired positive/negative) are varied
links.effect: Discriminatory behavior mediated through proxy variables in ED triage. LLMs systematically shifted perceived patient severity when specific tokens appeared, whether framed positively or negatively. No numeric results in abstract.
links.quote: Our results reveal discriminatory behavior mediated through proxy variables in ED triage scenarios, as well as a systematic tendency for LLMs to modify perceived patient severity when specific tokens appear in the input context, regardless of whether they are framed positively or negatively.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing for latent bias and equity issues in LLM-based emergency department triage using proxy variables on retrospective MIMIC datasets without evaluating a specific operational deployment guardrail or practice.
